entry.title: New: dsh-input-history
entry.summary: Standalone arrow-key input history for the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recalls sent prompts from one global ring shared across all sessions and workspaces, persisted to localStorage with an overridable cap. Exact install spec: github:sunshaobei/dsh-input-history. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
